Collaborative open dataset containing food product information contributed and maintained by citizens, including ingredients, nutritional values, brands and labels. The dataset is also available in RDF.

OpenHistoricalMap is a volunteer-mapped database documenting how the geography of the world has changed over time, covering historical borders, settlements, transport networks and place names, each annotated with its validity dates. Available in RDF Turtle and through a public SPARQL endpoint.
Citizen-generated dataset of aurora observations, including information on the observation time and location, sky conditions, aurora colors and types, duration, and images.

Dataset containing information about municipally owned dog areas in Madrid, including their location, surface area, and availability of play equipment for dogs.

Cultural Gems is a crowdsourced dataset of cultural and creative places in European cities and towns. The information is contributed by the community and the dataset follows Linked Open Data principles, providing data in RDF and other semantic formats.
Linked Open Data dataset of archaeological artifacts discovered and reported by citizen scientists in Finland.

The Cinema Context RDF dataset is a Linked Data representation converted from MySQL data of the Dutch Cinema Context. It uses RDF and Semantic Web vocabularies such as Schema.org, with links to external resources including IMDb and Wikidata, and is distributed in TriG format for SPARQL-based querying.
